title: Trainable Quantum-Native Language Models: Dissipative Memory, Capacity Limits, and Hardware Validation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12806v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study byte-level autoregressive language models whose hidden state is a small quantum register, whose transitions are learned token-conditioned quantum channels, and whose next-byte probabilities come directly from Born-rule measurements without a learned classical vocabulary projection or softmax. In the fixed-width recurrent setting, unitary dynamics cannot contract or reset stored distinctions; experimentally, unitary recurrence loses to its retrained one-token control in every tested variant. Introducing learned dissipation, then token-conditioned dissipative gating, yields useful memory beyond one token. The gated model improves test negative log-likelihood by 0.20 +/- 0.03 nats/byte over retrained parameter-matched one-token controls at context length 12, and by 0.29-0.33 at longer contexts, but never beats retrained two-token controls. translated_title: 可训练的原生量子语言模型：耗散记忆、容量极限与硬件验证
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一种字节级自回归语言模型，其隐藏状态是一个小型量子寄存器，其状态转移是通过学习得到的、以词元为条件的量子信道，其下一字节概率直接来自玻恩规则测量，而无需学习经典词表投影或softmax层。在固定宽度的循环设置中，幺正动力学无法收缩或重置已存储的区分信息；实验表明，幺正循环在所有测试变体中均不敌经过重新训练的单词元对照模型。引入可学习的耗散，进而引入以词元为条件的耗散门控，使模型产生了超越单个词元的有用记忆。在上下文长度为12时，门控模型相比参数量匹配的重新训练单词元对照模型，将测试负对数似然改善了0.20 ± 0.03 nats/byte；在更长的上下文中改善幅度为0.29–0.33，但始终无法超过重新训练的双词元对照模型。键值召回基准测试显示出依赖于宽度的阈值：一个存储的键值对满足p……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了以小型量子寄存器为隐藏状态、通过可学习词元条件量子信道转移并直接由玻恩规则测量输出概率的量子原生语言模型，发现可学习的词元条件耗散门控是实现超越单词元有用记忆的关键，其性能优于参数量匹配的单词元对照模型但不及双词元对照模型，从而揭示了此类量子语言模型的容量极限并通过硬件实验加以验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces quantum-native language models with small quantum-register hidden states, learned token-conditioned quantum channels, and Born-rule measurement outputs, showing that learned token-conditioned dissipative gating is essential for multi-token memory—outperforming parameter-matched one-token controls but never two-token controls—thereby revealing capacity limits and validating them on hardware.
